summary: The queue attributes the first RNG mismatch to attrib.c:exercise(), but that helper is already ported with the matching A_STR decrease draw. The C caller reached on step 44 is timeout.c:choke_dialogue(): after Amulet_on sets Strangled to 6 on step 43, nh_timeout() enters choke_dialogue(), whose i=6 value skips both dialogue arrays and unconditionally calls exercise(A_STR, FALSE). Frozen JS nh_timeout() records note_unported("timeout.c choke_dialogue") at this point, so it skips the rn2(2) draw and AEXE[STR] decrement; later dosounds consumes the next random value instead. The whole choke_dialogue() function, including its five-step message branches and caller wiring, is missing and is a file-port in timeout.c.

source.branch: Port the whole static choke_dialogue() function and its two file-local message arrays (278-314). It reads the Strangled timeout; when it is 1 through 5 it selects alternate or ordinary choking text, conditionally draws rn2(50), may stop occupation, and then always calls exercise(A_STR, FALSE). On this assigned path Amulet_on has just set Strangled to 6, so the i > 0 && i <= SIZE(choke_texts) branch is skipped; the unconditional strength exercise still draws rn2(2) and updates AEXE(STR). The frozen nh_timeout() callsite currently notes timeout.c choke_dialogue as unported, so the missing source unit requires both the helper and wiring from that callsite.
callers: C direct caller: timeout.c:nh_timeout() (629-630) calls choke_dialogue() whenever Strangled is nonzero. Frozen JS js/timeout.js:nh_timeout() (899-900) instead records note_unported("timeout.c choke_dialogue") for the live strangled state; replace this gap with the complete helper call.

C turn caller: allmain.c:moveloop_core() (270-274) invokes nh_timeout() during the elapsed-turn sequence. Frozen JS js/allmain.js:advanceElapsedTurn() (892-905) awaits nh_timeout() after turn resolution, which is the production path reached by the assigned space key.

Assigned setup path: do_wear.c:Amulet_on() (1036-1045), reached through accessory_or_armor_on(), identifies the newly worn strangulation amulet, sets Strangled=6, and prints the constriction message. Frozen JS js/do_wear.js:Amulet_on() (1001-1011) mirrors this setup, then the next elapsed turn reaches nh_timeout().
dependencies: attrib.c:exercise() (489-518) is already implemented in frozen js/attrib.js:exercise() (977-993). For this call, exercise(A_STR, FALSE) uses rn2(2), updates the Strength exercise accumulator, and after moves > 0 reaches C encumber_msg(); the JS exercise API therefore needs its encumberMessage hook. Frozen js/timeout.js already imports exercise and encumber_msg.

The C-only static arrays choke_texts and choke_texts2 (timeout.c:278-292) supply all five countdown messages. The assigned Strangled=6 state bypasses these arrays, but the complete source port must retain their i=1..5 behavior.

timeout.c:choke_dialogue() may call urgent_pline(), body_part(NECK), hcolor(NH_BLUE), and stop_occupation() in its in-range dialogue branches. Frozen timeout.js already imports ttyUrgentPline/urgent message support, body_part, hcolor, and stop_occupation; the assigned i=6 path does not enter those branches.

The first draw is setup, not the defect: do_wear.c:Amulet_on() calls makeknown(), which expands to discover_object(..., TRUE, TRUE, TRUE); o_init.c:discover_object() (454-484) calls exercise(A_WIS, TRUE) at 483. Frozen js/do_wear.js calls discover_object(), whose frozen js/o_init.js implementation invokes exercise_nonphysical(A_WIS, true) at 469. The saved trace shows matching rn2(19)=6 at step 43 before the later missing choke_dialogue draw.

evidence: The saved queue entry reports 45/45 screens and cursors, but 2586/2591 random calls; its first mismatch at step 44 is C rn2(2)=1 @ exercise(attrib.c:509) against JS rn2(400)=167 from dosounds. The assigned scan .cache/synthetic-scans/v14/tourist-wears-cursed-strangulation-amulet.json confirms 45 screens emitted, 45 recorded steps, and unported timeout.c choke_dialogue.

The immutable manifest challenges/manifests/v14.json traces do_wear.c:Amulet_on -> attrib.c:exercise and records the C call sequence: rn2(19)=6 at step 43, then rn2(2)=1 at step 44. The recording challenges/cases/v14/tourist-wears-cursed-strangulation-amulet.session.json confirms step 43 wears the amulet and displays the strangulation status; step 44 advances the turn and has the rn2(2) exercise draw.

C nethack-c/upstream/src/do_wear.c:1036-1045 calls makeknown(), sets Strangled=6, and reports “It constricts your throat!”; C nethack-c/upstream/src/o_init.c:454-484 shows that makeknown() credits Wisdom through exercise(A_WIS, TRUE). This explains the preceding rn2(19) draw, which frozen JS also performs through discover_object() and exercise_nonphysical().

The actual missing source owner is nethack-c/upstream/src/timeout.c:choke_dialogue() (278-314), not attrib.c:exercise(). At assigned step 44, i=(Strangled & TIMEOUT)=6, larger than the five text rows, so the dialogue/rn2(50)/stop-occupation branch is skipped and the unconditional exercise(A_STR, FALSE) at line 313 consumes rn2(2). nethack-c/upstream/src/timeout.c:nh_timeout() calls it at 629-630.

Frozen examined JS at 3212f9f07c3fdf3f00c5c204885f51834f0b6448 already ports attrib.c:exercise() in js/attrib.js. Frozen js/timeout.js:nh_timeout() instead skips the helper at 899-900 with note_unported("timeout.c choke_dialogue"); the next JS draw is dosounds rn2(400), explaining the queue mismatch without attributing it to a defect in exercise().

Production reachability is allmain.c:moveloop_core() -> timeout.c:nh_timeout() -> timeout.c:choke_dialogue(); the assigned recording reaches it after the cursed amulet is put on and the following turn advances. It currently matches every screen/cursor but not RNG; after the whole helper is ported and the gap wired, this case can provide runtime evidence for the i=6 branch through zero-based segment 0, step 44. The i=1..5 dialogue branches remain unexercised.
